item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `PromptOptimizer` and `WeightOptimizer` with distinct `compile()` knobs (`num_trials` vs `num_batches`) and each records received kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds a minimal `SimpleModule` around `dspy.Predict(\"input -> output\")`, instantiates it, and sets a `DummyLM` before compile."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Instantiates `BetterTogether(metric=metric, p=prompt_opt, w=weight_opt)` and calls `compile(..., strategy=\"p -> w\", optimizer_compile_args={\"p\": {\"num_trials\": 10}, \"w\": {\"num_batches\": 5}})`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"0.5","rationale":"Uses optimizer-specific `compile()` signatures with valid step args, but does not actually test or assert that invalid keys are rejected."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"The observed behavior shows shared input plus step-local args are routed per optimizer, with nonmatching step args not reaching the other optimizer."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `num_trials == 10` only on the prompt optimizer and `num_batches == 5` only on the weight optimizer, with the cross-step arg absent or `None`."},{"claim_id":"c7","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `eval_candidate_program`, `launch_lms`, and `kill_lms`, and forces `_models_changed` to `False`, keeping the repro offline and side-effect free."}],"question_score":92.5,"needs_regrade":false}
